book.name: 2 CORINTIOS
book.title: ISCAB CARTA NAJ SAN PABLO YATO TET MACTA AYXACO YUL ISKꞌAB COMAM BEY CORINTO

content: Ismunil naj Pablo haꞌ yalnicꞌo Istzotiꞌ Comam Dios

Hanin Pablo intiꞌan yet chinkꞌannihan hunu tzet ye tuꞌ teyet hacaꞌ iscꞌulchꞌanil iscꞌul Comam Cristo hac tuꞌ chu inkꞌannihan. Tolab chihallaxicꞌoj tato yet ayinan texol caw echo inxiwan, wal yet machijinan texol xin, tolab caw can̈ chiwute inbahan yalbanil.

Yajaꞌ chiwaltojan teyet ta hayet chinapnihan bey tuꞌ machojab cheyakꞌtij inhowalan yin̈ ebnaj chalni tato lahan chijute cobahan̈ hacaꞌ comon anma, yuto hanintiꞌan caw hinaninan intzotelan yin̈ huneꞌ tuꞌ yeb ebnaj.
Wal xin caw yeli anma on̈an̈, yaj mach hacaꞌo chu yakꞌni anma howal, mach haco tuꞌ jakꞌni howalan̈.
Maẍtaj tzet ye tuꞌ yet yul sat yiban̈kꞌinal tiꞌ chijakꞌbaln̈e yet chijakꞌni howal, walxinto haꞌ yip Comam Dios haꞌ chikꞌoji istan̈tzenilo sunil tzet ye tuꞌ caw ay yip.
Chikꞌojipaxo yip Comam yin̈ sunil loloꞌal mach chichahni ohtan̈elaxo Comam Dios. Haxa comon nabale xin chijacanico sunil tuꞌ yul iskꞌab Comam Jesucristo, hac tuꞌ xin yijem chute isba.
Hayet caw cꞌul hexxa heyijeni, chijayojan̈ isyaꞌtajil yiban̈ mac mach chisje iscꞌul isyijeꞌ.
Hex tiꞌ, han̈echꞌan tzet cheyil yu isbakꞌ hesat haꞌn̈e chexoc hetxumuꞌ. Ta tꞌin̈anxa heyehi tato yet hexxa Comam Cristo, yilal heyohtan̈eniloj tato yetpaxo Comam Cristo jehan̈.
Waxan̈ca chiwican̈ hanicꞌ inbahan yin̈ huneꞌ inmuniltiꞌan, yajaꞌ mach chintxꞌixwihan, yuto haꞌ Comam Dios akꞌn̈e huneꞌ inmuniltiꞌan yun̈e helin̈ban heba yin̈ Comam, maẍtaj yu quexwetantojan.
Yuxin mach chisje incꞌulan ta chetxumu ta yu quexinxibtenan yuxin hac tiꞌ chiwute walnitojan yul incartatiꞌan, wal xin machoj.
Yuto ay mac chalni hacaꞌ tiꞌ: “Haꞌ iscarta naj caw how istzoteli, yeb xin caw yaꞌ chilowi, yajaꞌ haxa yet aycꞌo naj coxol xin machi yip tzet chiyal naj yeb xin matzet chal yelapnoj,” ẍi ebnaj.
Haꞌ mac hac tuꞌ yalni, yilal yohtan̈eni tato hacaꞌticꞌa intzotelan yul incartatiꞌan, hac tuꞌ chu intzotelpaxojan yet ayinan texol.
Wal xin mach chu colahban cobahan̈ yeb mac chisloloꞌn̈e isba. Haꞌ huntekꞌan ebnaj tuꞌ chischahco ebnaj sucal yin̈ yu chꞌoc ebnaj yilaꞌ hanta ishelanil hunun ebnaj.

Han̈on̈tiꞌan̈ mach chon̈palcꞌonan̈ jinican̈ cobahan̈ bay yebilcano jetan̈, yuto haꞌ Comam Dios an̈ecanico yechel bay cachan comunlahan̈. Hac tuꞌ xin el yin̈ iscꞌul Comam yuxin con̈apnihan̈ texol bey con̈ob Corinto tuꞌ.
Kꞌinalo tato maẍticꞌa hunelo con̈apnihan̈ tecꞌatan̈, machim chon̈munlahan̈ texol tinan̈. Wal xin han̈on̈an̈ con̈apnihan̈ babel texol, jalnihan̈ Tzotiꞌ cꞌul yet colbanile yin̈ Comam Cristo teyet.

Mach chijal cobahan̈ winajil yu ismunil hunuxa anma, yeb xin mach lan̈an copalcꞌonan̈ comunlahan̈ yiban̈ bay yebilon̈canojan̈ yu Comam. Wal xin caw chito jochehan̈ chon̈munlahan̈ yun̈e ischꞌib comuniltuꞌan̈ bay cachan comunlahan̈ yu Comam Dios, yun̈e cam heyanico heyanma yin̈ Comam.

Chijochepaxojan̈ chon̈hitztojan̈ jalnojan̈ Tzotiꞌ yet colbanile yul huntekꞌanxa con̈ob nahat yehilo yin̈ hecon̈ob tuꞌ. Yajaꞌ xin mach chijochehan̈ chon̈munlahan̈ bay xaichico hunmajanxa ebnaj ismunlahi, yuto machi jochehan̈ cololoꞌn̈e cobahan̈ yin̈ ismunil hunuxa maca.
Ta ay hunu mac choche yikꞌaꞌcan̈ isba, yikꞌabcan̈ isba yaj yin̈ tzet chiswatxꞌe Comam Dios, machojabtaj yin̈ tzet chiswatxꞌe.
Yuto maẍtaj anma chiyal isba cꞌulal yul yet ischuquil haꞌ cꞌul, machoj, walxinto haꞌ mac chal Comam cꞌulal, haꞌ ton cꞌul.

footnotes.text: Yin̈ versículo 7-9 chiꞌilcha huneꞌ chihallax ironia; haꞌ chal yelapno tuꞌ to hayet chon̈makꞌach abixli yin̈ hunuxa maca yun̈e yel ispixan.
